interpretations: Average each production type’s nonmissing unit prices. Keep types whose average exceeds the overall average of nonmissing product prices, then keep only those whose average also exceeds the simple mean of the first set’s type averages. Return one row containing the averages, across the final types, of their type averages and their differences from each threshold.
queries:
WITH nonmissing_prices AS (
    SELECT production_type_code, unit_price
    FROM Products
    WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price
    FROM nonmissing_prices
),
type_averages AS (
    SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price
    FROM nonmissing_prices
    GROUP BY production_type_code
),
first_set AS (
    SELECT t.avg_price
    FROM type_averages AS t
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
    WHERE t.avg_price > o.avg_price
),
first_set_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price
    FROM first_set
)
SELECT
    AVG(f.avg_price) AS average_type_average,
    AVG(f.avg_price - o.avg_price) AS average_difference_from_overall,
    AVG(f.avg_price - s.avg_price) AS average_difference_from_first_set
FROM first_set AS f
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
CROSS JOIN first_set_average AS s
WHERE f.avg_price > s.avg_price
